_source: LHY Combat Tables v2026.10.19 (2 pp.) and Game Tracks v5.1.2023; transcribed 2026-11-18. Red numbers on the charts are negative DRMs [Intro].

range._doc: key = firing unit's printed SAV range; value = list of [min_hex, max_hex, drm]

mortar_fire_action._doc: mv = [primary, secondary]; markers = number of MDRM / SMK markers. 76-82mm Sec MDRM '3' is printed in red on the chart (see open question).

anti_tank_resolution.destroyed_if: final > AV (or AEV if enfilade marker)
anti_tank_resolution.shocked_if: AFV and (final == AV/AEV or (unmodified 10 and final >= AV-2))
anti_tank_resolution.no_effect_if: target is a vehicle and unmodified roll <= 2

small_arms_mortar_resolution.disrupt_if: final > cohesion of best non-vehicular combat unit (casualty instead if already disrupted, heroic, Russian/Japanese); others in hex take cohesion checks
small_arms_mortar_resolution.casualty_if: final >= 10: best unit suffers casualty and disrupts; others take cohesion checks
small_arms_mortar_resolution.mortar_76mm_plus_unmodified_10: one random vehicle in primary impact hex: carrier/FV destroyed, AFV shocked

steps: defender retreats 4 hexes; retreating non-vehicular units suffer a casualty and disrupt unless already disrupted (RU/JP: best unit casualty, others cohesion check, casualty if fail)
attacker may advance once into adjacent hex; assault if occupied
defender retreats: disrupted retreating non-vehicular units suffer a casualty; undisrupted disrupt, retreat and cohesion check, casualty if fail (RU/JP: best unit casualty)
urban assault: unmodified 6 or 7 -> best attacking and defending combat unit each suffer a casualty
defender retreats: retreating non-vehicular units cohesion check (RU/JP: best unit check, casualty if fail)
mark all undisrupted attacking/defending non-vehicular units regrouping
urban assault: unmodified 4 or 5 -> best attacking combat unit suffers a casualty
attacker retreats: retreating non-vehicular units cohesion check (RU/JP: best unit check, casualty if fail)
mark all undisrupted attacking/defending non-vehicular units regrouping
attacker retreats: disrupted retreating non-vehicular units suffer a casualty; undisrupted disrupt, retreat and cohesion check, casualty if fail (RU/JP: best unit casualty)
attacking units retreat 4 hexes; retreating non-vehicular units suffer a casualty and disrupt unless already disrupted (RU/JP: best unit casualty, others cohesion check)
defender may advance once into adjacent hex; assault if occupied by an enemy unit

friendly_force_includes_undisrupted.if: any squad or fortified position; or German MG or infantry section after 9/43; or Japanese/Russian reduced squad or section
unit with ATV >= 0; or German squad or FP after 9/43
a heroic unit; or American/British section; or Japanese/Russian squad; or a unit with Assault Value 3

enemy_vehicle_is.if: unsupported (no other undisrupted or non-shocked combat unit in the hex) and in or adjacent to a cover-terrain hex, hexside or IP
in a sunken road hex entered from a hex that is not a contiguous road hex

terrain._doc: level; mp = [non-vehicular, track, half-track, wheel] (P = prohibited, OT = other terrain); tem = [small arms, mortar]; blocking: hex | feature | none

orchard_palm_brush.blocking: hex if different levels; hindrance if same level

hill.note: MP per bold contour crossed uphill, not along a road

_footnotes.1: TEMs are not cumulative; only the one most beneficial to the defender is used.
_footnotes.2: Terrain in bold black = blocking hexes; bold red = blocking terrain features.
_footnotes.3: MP cost per bold contour line crossed when maneuvering uphill; not applicable along a road.
_footnotes.4: Left TEM is small arms, right TEM is mortar.
_footnotes.5: Palm groves/orchard/brush block LOS of units on different levels; hindrance on the same level [4.2.4].
_footnotes.6: 1 1/2 to enter and All to maneuver from one river/marsh hex to another.
_footnotes.7: Use other terrain in the hex if entered from a non-road/non-railroad hex.
_footnotes.8: +1 for each tree line crossed or when exiting a forest road hex into any hex without a connecting road [4.1.9.1a].

blind_hex._doc: rows = level difference 1..5; columns = hexes from the highest hex to the intervening terrain 1..20. 0* means 1 when the adjacent hex contains a forest hex or intersects a building or tree-line feature.

casualty_track._doc: box -> casualty points; attacker side boxes 1..8 add CP to elapsed time (black), defender side boxes 1..8 subtract (red). Russian/Japanese: 1 CP per box.

_fate_texts.medic: A prior casualty returns: randomly select and return a single MG or infantry section from a platoon that suffered a casualty, adjust the casualty track; placed concealed if in cover terrain, with or as close as possible to a unit of the same platoon (any platoon if MG) and not adjacent to an enemy unit. If no prior casualty, all units in a single hex recover instead; if no non-vehicular units in play, recover one AFV selected at random.
_fate_texts.recover: Recover all disrupted, regrouping and shocked units in any single hex.
_fate_texts.sniper: One randomly selected non-hidden platoon leader suffers a casualty; if none in play, one randomly selected AFV is shocked.
_fate_texts.indecision: Loss of initiative to the opposing player (reroll if both players are indecisive).
_fate_texts.panic: As the sole action this turn, all units in a single hex selected by the opposing player move four hexes toward, but no further than, their FBE (NA to towed guns or fortified positions).
